name: Training the Beast
summary: Training the Beast is the culminating rite of passage for young orc and troll hunters in Durotar. After demonstrating mastery over the wild beasts of the plains, hunters are sent from Razor Hill to Orgrimmar to study under veteran master hunter Ormak Grimshot. Completing this journey teaches the novice how to care for, feed, and hone the skills of their lifelong animal companion.

sections.title: A Journey Beyond the Wilderness
sections.body: In the arid canyon lands of Durotar, mastering a bow and surviving the harsh elements is only half of a hunter's duty. After proving their resilience by taming Durotar's fierce boars, crab scavengers, and armored scorpid stalkers, young hunters are ready for the true responsibility of stewardship. Thotar, stationed in Razor Hill, dispatches them north through the red clay gulches straight to the fortified gates of Orgrimmar.

sections.title: The Valley of Honor
sections.body: Within the bustling capital, aspiring track-masters must seek out the Valley of Honor, an enclave where warrior spirits and veteran stalkers hone their craft. There dwells Ormak Grimshot, one of the Horde's most revered master hunters. Ormak looks past raw youth to see whether a hunter possesses the patience required not just to command a beast, but to sustain and nurture it through famine, battle, and loss.

sections.title: Bonding with the Wild
sections.body: A beast won through force of will remains wild until an understanding is forged between hunter and companion. Ormak imparts the sacred traditions required to maintain that bond: the knowledge of which foods nourish each creature's spirit, the discipline needed to teach them lethal techniques, and the spiritual focus required to revive a fallen beast should it collapse in the line of duty.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Training the Beast?
aliases: where to start training the beast
faq.answer: Thotar, the hunter trainer situated outside the barracks in Razor Hill, offers this task once you have successfully subdued all three test creatures across Durotar.

faq.q: Where can I find Ormak Grimshot?
faq.answer: Ormak Grimshot resides in the Valley of Honor, an eastern district within the capital city of Orgrimmar, alongside other veteran hunter and warrior mentors.

faq.q: What skills does Ormak Grimshot teach you?
faq.answer: Ormak teaches you how to train your companion with active and passive abilities, how to feed your pet to keep it loyal and content, and how to revive it if it dies in combat.

faq.q: Why do orc and troll hunters have to visit Orgrimmar for this?
faq.answer: Local trainers like Thotar can teach basic wilderness survival, but advanced beast mastery is preserved by the Horde's elder scouts and venerated trackers like Ormak Grimshot in the capital.

faq.q: Do other Horde races undertake this exact quest?
faq.answer: No. This specific rite is designed for orc and troll hunters starting in Durotar. Tauren hunters undertake a parallel ritual in Mulgore under their own tribal masters.

faq.q: What happens if a hunter neglects to complete this training?
aliases: do i need to do this
can i skip training the beast
faq.answer: Without finishing this instruction, a hunter cannot feed, properly train, or resurrect their companion, rendering any captured beast unhappy, weak, and ultimately prone to abandoning them.

angles.text: This quest marks the moment your pet becomes a permanent, dependable ally rather than a fleeting summon, unlocking the essential Feed Pet and Revive Pet arts.
Orcs view the bond with their hunting companion as a matter of martial honor and duty, a partnership tested in battle across the harsh frontiers of Durotar.
For Darkspear trolls carving out a new home in Kalimdor, learning to commune with Durotar's savage creatures is vital for scouting and surviving in unfamiliar soil.
The Horde relies on its scouts and beasts to secure the fragile borders of Durotar and the Barrens against centaur, quilboar, and Alliance incursions.
